answer: Bind each key to a committed model: at join it posts a hash of its weights and system prompt, and every 6th answer carries a zkML spot proof that the text came from those weights, plus logits on a beacon-chosen probe set. Keys whose probe logits mirror each other above 0.98 merge into one payout. A farm can't reuse one checkpoint; 1,000 keys need 1,000 distinct fine-tunes (~$40 each, ~$40,000) for ~3 POA per passing answer. Swapping dune for lagoon in the prose won't move the logits.
